overall_goal: Build a FastAPI notes service with token auth, SQLite persistence, and pytest coverage.
assumptions: A standard src layout is acceptable.
SQLite is sufficient for local development.
risks: Auth middleware and route handlers must agree on token extraction semantics.
Database session lifecycle must be consistent across tests and runtime.

frozen_interfaces.name: Auth token dependency
frozen_interfaces.contract: A FastAPI dependency named require_token(request) that returns the caller token or raises HTTP 401.

frozen_interfaces.name: Repository protocol
frozen_interfaces.contract: Functions create_note(session, payload), list_notes(session), and delete_note(session, note_id).

modules.title: Project skeleton and runtime configuration
modules.description: Create the application package, settings, dependency wiring, and entrypoint.

files.purpose: FastAPI app construction and router wiring

modules.title: Persistence layer
modules.description: Define the SQLAlchemy model, session factory, and repository functions for note CRUD.

modules.title: Auth middleware and dependency
modules.description: Implement token validation dependency and shared auth error handling.
interface_contracts: Auth token dependency frozen in planning

unit_tests: Auth dependency rejects missing or invalid tokens

modules.title: API routes
modules.description: Create note routes that depend on the repository and auth modules.

files.purpose: HTTP handlers for create, list, and delete

interface_contracts: Routes call repository functions and auth dependency exactly as frozen

integration_tests: API route tests for auth and CRUD behavior

modules.title: Test suite
modules.description: Add pytest coverage for repository, auth, and API routes.
interface_contracts: Tests reflect the frozen repository and auth contracts

completion_criteria: The API can create, list, and delete notes.
Token auth is enforced on note routes.
Repository and route tests exist and are runnable with pytest.
notes: Wave 2 is the only safe parallel wave because the auth and persistence modules do not overlap in file ownership and their interfaces are frozen.
